yoast_head_json.title: Michelangelus - New Typeface by Studiogusto
yoast_head_json.description: Michelangelus is a typeface designed by Studiogusto® for the Fabbrica di San Pietro in Vaticano, licensed to and distributed by Microsoft.

sections.eyebrow: The master’s soul, set in type
sections.heading: A timeless serif, rooted in the spirit and grace of the San Pietro Basilica and the Pietà, drawn from the handwriting of a Renaissance master — Michelangelo.
sections.body: The greatest works of the Renaissance artists followed the rules of clear proportions. Their universal beauty made them easy to comprehend and egalitarian. Similarly, the Michelangelus font is made for clear communication, it keeps the natural flow of writing and turns thoughts into words, giving each one weight and importance.

sections.heading: Sublime proportion, rhythm and harmony: measured by the artist’s eye, translated into digital system.
sections.body: Michelangelo’s exceptional calligraphy was led by unmistakable intuition. A digital typeface required the opposite — every curve, line and serif has to be designed with mathematical precision, consistent across 500+ glyphs, keeping the beauty of the maestros’ style.

sections.title: From the personal voice to monumental presence
sections.text: We closely studied over 300 manuscripts by Michelangelo. To design the lowercase letters we entered the artist’s private world, studying his handwriting and the curves of his signature. Zooming out from the page to his only autograph on Pieta and inscription on St. Peter’s dome, we shaped the uppercase letters, tracing the bond between the artist and his greatest work. A more resonant voice in capital letters, marking his personality and his work of art.

sections.title: Renaissance polyphony of styles and characters
sections.text: Michelangelo is a well-balanced, elegant, and classic font in four styles: Regular, Italic, Bold, and Bold Italic. It can be used widely for editorial content, titles, documents, and institutional purposes. But while remaining versatile, it never loses its identity. It does not blend in or dissolve. Michelangelo’s style remains present in every setting, shining through in every contour.

sections.title: Glyphset
sections.text: The Michelangelus font system is built on a set of Latin characters adapted for use across many languages. Alongside the core glyph set, it includes ligatures, stylistic alternates, contextual forms, fractions, symbols, arrows, currencies, and a distinctive collection of historical and religious marks — crosses, Chi-Rho, liturgical marks, and related symbols. Additionally the italics feature initial forms and alternate letters, giving the typeface a more calligraphic quality.
